s1.title: 1. Who We Are
s1.body: Croma is a product by Aurora33 (we, us, our). We operate the image compression tool available at croma.aurora33.dev. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your personal data when you use our Service.

s2.title: 2. Data We Collect
s2.intro: We collect the following categories of personal data:

items.label: Account data:
items.text: email address and encrypted password when you register

items.label: Usage data:
items.text: number of compression jobs, file counts, and usage metrics tied to your account

items.label: Technical data:
items.text: IP address, browser type, and session data collected automatically via logs

items.label: Uploaded files:
items.text: images are processed in-memory and deleted automatically after one hour — we do not store or inspect their contents

s3.title: 3. How We Use Your Data
s3.intro: We use your personal data for the following purposes:

items.label: Service delivery:
items.text: to operate your account, apply usage limits, and provide compression features

items.label: Product communications:
items.text: to send you updates, new features, and improvements related to Croma

items.label: Marketing by Aurora33:
items.text: to inform you about other products, tools, and services developed or offered by Aurora33

items.label: Promotional offers:
items.text: to send promotional campaigns, discounts, and special offers for Aurora33 products and selected third-party partnerships

items.label: Newsletter:
items.text: if you opted in at registration, to send you our periodic newsletter covering product news, tips, and updates

items.label: Analytics:
items.text: to understand how the Service is used and improve it

items.label: Legal compliance:
items.text: to meet applicable legal obligations

s3.outro: Marketing and newsletter emails are only sent to users who explicitly consented at the time of registration. You may withdraw this consent at any time (see Section 7).

s4.title: 4. Legal Basis for Processing
s4.intro: We process your personal data under the following legal bases:

items.label: Contract performance:
items.text: to provide the Service you signed up for

items.label: Consent:
items.text: for marketing emails, newsletters, and promotional communications — you gave explicit consent at registration

items.label: Legitimate interest:
items.text: for product analytics and service improvements

items.label: Legal obligation:
items.text: where required by applicable law

s5.title: 5. Data Sharing
s5.intro: We do not sell your personal data. We may share your data with:

items.label: Service providers:
items.text: trusted third-party vendors (hosting, database, email delivery) who process data on our behalf under data processing agreements

items.label: Aurora33 group:
items.text: other products or projects operated under the Aurora33 umbrella, solely for the purposes described in Section 3

items.label: Legal authorities:
items.text: when required by law or to protect the rights and safety of Aurora33 or its users

s6.title: 6. Data Retention
s6.body: We retain your account data for as long as your account is active. Uploaded image files are automatically deleted after one hour of inactivity. If you delete your account, we will erase your personal data within 30 days, except where retention is required by law.

s7.title: 7. Your Rights
s7.intro: Depending on your jurisdiction, you may have the following rights regarding your personal data:

items.label: Access:
items.text: request a copy of the data we hold about you

items.label: Rectification:
items.text: correct inaccurate or incomplete data

items.label: Erasure:
items.text: request deletion of your data (right to be forgotten)

items.label: Objection:
items.text: object to data processing based on legitimate interest

items.label: Withdraw consent:
items.text: unsubscribe from marketing or newsletter emails at any time by clicking the unsubscribe link in any email or contacting us directly

items.label: Portability:
items.text: request your data in a structured, machine-readable format

s7.outro: To exercise any of these rights, contact us at

s8.title: 8. Cookies
s8.body: We use essential cookies to maintain your session and language preferences. We do not use third-party advertising cookies. You can disable cookies in your browser settings, though this may affect Service functionality.

s9.title: 9. Security
s9.body: We implement industry-standard security measures including encrypted passwords (bcrypt), HTTPS transport, and restricted server access. However, no system is completely secure. We encourage you to use a strong, unique password for your account.

s10.title: 10. Changes to This Policy
s10.body: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will update the Last updated date at the top of this page. Continued use of the Service after changes constitutes your acceptance of the revised Policy.

s11.title: 11. Contact
s11.body: For privacy-related questions or to exercise your rights, contact Aurora33 at
